data.name: Graph_user_sourceOfAuthority
data.value: Where the user is managed, derived by JIM: cloud (in Entra ID, so JIM can write to it through Microsoft Graph), onPremisesDirectory (synchronized from Active Directory, so most attributes are written there instead) or externalEntraDirectory (a guest from another tenant). An object whose Source of Authority was switched to Entra ID reads as cloud only with Track Source of Authority Changes on. Flow it into a Metaverse Attribute to scope export Synchronization Rules on it.
